source: Direct researcher acceptance in the current session

accepted_items.title: representation_readout_mismatch_preferred_over_lfe_information_loss
accepted_items.decision: Current evidence is more consistent with representation-readout mismatch than with demonstrated disappearance of the attribute in the LFE.
accepted_items.permitted_explanation: Stage-specific upstream EVA linear readability can coexist with mixed mean-pooled LFE margins if attribute-related structure is reorganized, distributed across the 32 LFE tokens, or inaccessible to the frozen mean-pooled linear direction.
accepted_items.prohibited_upgrade: The existing experiment does not establish that attribute information is absent from or lost in the full LFE representation.

accepted_items.title: multi_route_distributed_representation
accepted_items.decision: Multi-route distributed representation remains the most defensible working model.
accepted_items.basis: Static mapping verifies coexisting local identity-token and spatial reference-latent conditioning paths, while the current trace measures only bounded aspects of the local path.
accepted_items.prohibited_upgrade: Mixed pooled-LFE results do not establish that the local route is unused, and the working model does not establish route contribution, interaction, necessity, sufficiency, or a bottleneck.

accepted_items.title: scalar_residual_rms_is_mechanistically_incomplete
accepted_items.decision: Scalar residual RMS is likely an insufficient observation for the full mechanism.
accepted_items.basis: All 36 fixed injection cells contain both positive and negative pair differences, so local residual magnitude has no uniform attribute direction in this fixed panel.
unverified_hypotheses: alignment with the current video or query state may matter
interaction across conditioning paths may matter
accepted_items.prohibited_upgrade: This does not establish that RMS is useless, that residuals lack attribute content, or that the local route is irrelevant.

accepted_items.title: unmapped_preprocessing_heterogeneity
accepted_items.decision: Preprocessing heterogeneity is a plausible but retrospectively untraceable source of variation.
accepted_items.basis: The 76 fallback messages have no task identifier and therefore cannot be assigned to a task or formal pair.
accepted_items.required_handling: Retain all 160 tasks and report fallback only as a run-level limitation; do not assign, exclude, impute, rerun, or construct pair-level fallback explanations.

accepted_items.title: linkage_tests_fixed_panel_covariation_only
accepted_items.decision: The planned linkage can test only whether frozen readout heterogeneity descriptively co-varies with frozen outcome heterogeneity in each fixed attribute panel.
accepted_items.positive_primary_interpretation: A positive primary Spearman coefficient would support only same-direction fixed-panel co-variation between the pooled-LFE margin and retention outcome.
accepted_items.near_zero_or_negative_primary_interpreta: A near-zero or negative coefficient would not refute the LFE or local route because readout mismatch, multi-route compensation, and measurement heterogeneity remain possible.
accepted_items.secondary_interpretation: Complete secondary stage and injection-grid families may describe stage dependence but cannot localize a mechanism or support favorable stage or cell selection.

evidence_vocabulary.verified_fact: directly supported by a frozen artifact, SHA256 value, or independent verification record
evidence_vocabulary.current_observation: a descriptive pattern in the fixed finite panel
evidence_vocabulary.accepted_working_model: a researcher-approved explanation class not established by intervention or outcome linkage
evidence_vocabulary.unverified_hypothesis: a prospective explanation requiring a new test
evidence_vocabulary.research_decision: an approved scope, interpretation, or authorization boundary
